title: Refund policy
lead: Our rules on payments, cancellations, and refund eligibility

within14.title: Cancelling within 14 days
within14.body: Subscriptions to plans (yearly or monthly) can only be cancelled within 14 days of their first activation, and refunds of the amounts paid are processed within 14 days.

after14.title: Cancelling after 14 days
after14.body: If you cancel a subscription to a paid plan more than 14 days after it was activated, you can keep using the plan and its benefits until the subscription's end date, and the subscription fee cannot be refunded.

autoRenew.title: Automatic renewal
autoRenew.body: When automatic subscription renewal is turned on, the subscription fee is processed automatically as soon as the new subscription invoice is issued.

afterDelivery.title: No refunds after the service is delivered
afterDelivery.body: No refund will be issued in cases where the customer changes their mind after the service has been delivered as promised.

promotions.title: Promotions and discounts
promotions.body: Approved refunds for services purchased through promotional offers or discounts are processed based on the actual amount the customer paid.

helpBody: For questions about refunds and payments
